judge_context: A faithful summary must name the NullPointerException in AuthService.validate, cite the correlationId/traceId/requestId from the evidence, reflect the 25x volume spike, and rate severity critical.
Coverage is full and nothing was found. A faithful summary must state plainly that the log groups were checked and no issues were detected, must NOT invent problems, and severity should be none.

Coverage is partial (anomaly detection failed on kyc-core, results sampled, evidence_grade low). A faithful summary must call out the partial coverage and lower confidence, surface the AccessDenied s3:GetObject error with its requestId, must NOT rate severity above medium given the weak evidence, and must not fabricate log group names.
A faithful summary must surface the HTTP 429 throttling spike (~9x baseline) on kyc-gateway, cite the sessionId/traceId, and rate severity high.

Coverage is partial: error-patterns on kyc-core failed with throttling even after a reduced-scope retry, while kyc-auth returned a real TimeoutException finding (88 occurrences, requestId req-Zz99Yy88Xx). A faithful summary must surface the kyc-auth timeout finding with its requestId, explicitly call out that kyc-core could not be fully analyzed (partial coverage), must NOT rate severity above medium given the degraded coverage, and must NOT fabricate findings for kyc-core.

The alarm kyc-payments-error-rate is currently in ALARM and is flapping (6 state transitions in 24h). A faithful summary must name the flapping alarm kyc-payments-error-rate, treat it as an unstable/flapping signal rather than a clean steady-state failure, surface the payment authorization rejections, and rate severity high given a firing alarm on full coverage.

Logs are quiet (no error patterns or anomalies) but the Lambda Throttles metric for kyc-auth is spiking (latest 95, max 95) alongside ConcurrentExecutions pinned near 1000 (concurrency saturation). A faithful summary must surface the throttling metric spike from the metrics evidence (not the logs) and connect it to concurrency saturation. It must NOT claim there are no issues just because the logs are clean.

The scan budget was reached so coverage is partial and results were sampled (budget_limited, sampled, evidence_grade low). A faithful summary must surface the connection pool exhaustion finding with its requestId (req-Bb22Cc44Dd), explicitly call out that coverage is reduced/sampled (not complete), must NOT rate severity above medium given the degraded evidence, and must NOT claim the data is exhaustive.

Two regions were checked. us-east-1 has a DynamoDB ProvisionedThroughputExceededException spike (requestId req-Useast1Aa); eu-west-1 is clean. A faithful summary must attribute the DynamoDB throttling specifically to us-east-1 (not generalise it across both regions), state that eu-west-1 was clean, surface the requestId, and must NOT invent findings for eu-west-1.

Coverage is partial across regions: us-east-1 returned an Upstream 503 from billing-svc finding (requestId req-Useast1Bb) but ap-south-1 could not be analyzed (AccessDenied on logs:StartQuery). A faithful summary must surface the us-east-1 503 finding with its requestId, explicitly call out that ap-south-1 was not analyzed due to access denied (partial coverage), must NOT rate severity above medium given the gap, and must NOT fabricate ap-south-1 findings.
